patches.description: In the order the collection lists them. A patch is named once.

main.description: A titled, ordered list of at.atmosynth.patch records.

patchRef.description: One patch in the collection, by its address. Not a strong reference: a collection keeps a patch as its creator goes on changing it, and a patch since deleted is simply one the collection can no longer show.

description: A collection of synth patches, held in its creator's own repository: a title, a description and the patches it gathers — the creator's own or anybody's — in the order they are listed.
